checks.name: multi-document transaction commits the complete transfer
transaction exception rolls back its partial transfer
snapshot transaction retains its read view after another session commits
real transient write conflict causes callback retry and fresh reads
purchase commits trusted price snapshot stock order and outbox together
same-key replay returns original result without repeating stock or outbox
same key with changed quantity is a conflict
same key and SKU in another tenant form an independent operation
invalid quantity shapes and bounds fail before writes
unavailable stock rolls back the unique pending gate
failure after decrement rolls back stock order and outbox
barrier-started distinct-key purchases cannot both consume the last unit
barrier-started duplicate purchases create one order and one replay
committed replay still succeeds when stock is zero
rolled-back unavailable key can succeed after later restock

scope: Real single-member replica-set transactions and concurrent service calls; no failover or HTTP/provider delivery
